standard-dialogue.npc: My name is Brew'ma. I'm here to assist adventurers like you with potion making.
If you hand me a herb from the Bruma tree and one of the unfinished potions from the crate, I can combine the two if you lack the... talent to do so yourself.

using-items.text: Using a Bruma herb with no Unfinished potions:

steps.npc: You don't have any unfinished potions on you. I can't use the herbs without them.

steps.text: Brew'ma quickly mixes zero Rejuvenation potions.

using-items.text: Using an Unfinished Rejuvenation potion without any Bruma herbs:

steps.npc: You don't have any Bruma herbs on you. I need them to finish the potions.

using-items.text: Using a Bruma herb with 1 Unfinished potion:

steps.text: Brew'ma quickly mixes a Rejuvenation potion.

using-items.text: Using more than 1 Bruma herb with more than 1 Unfinished potion:
Using any other item on them:

steps.npc: Sorry, I can't do anything with that.
